2. [Paper and SI analyses](analysis.html) (`analysis.qmd`)
3. Figures and tables in [`2_figures/`](2_figures/)
4. Assignment universe (not respondent data): [`1_input/`](1_input/)

Paper and SI object labels are listed at the top of `analysis.qmd`.
